content:
The image displays a leaf with dark, superficial fungal deposits covering its surface. The leaf itself appears to be green underneath these black spots. This presentation strongly matches the description of Sooty Mould, which is characterized by dark, superficial fungal growth on leaves that remains on the surface. The symptoms do not align with Anthracnose (which involves expanding black spots that form dead areas), Die_Back (which affects twigs and causes leaves to brown and roll), or Powdery Mildew (which would appear as a white, powdery substance).
